Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain forest practices from the requirements of the hydraulic code.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain forest practices from therequirements of the hydraulic code; and adding a new section to chapter77.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The requirements of RCW 77.55.021 are to be considered satisfiedfor any project that is required under chapter 76.09 RCW to submit aforest practices application, or that is associated with any projectthat is required under chapter 76.09 RCW to submit a forest practicesapplication, as long as the project is limited to one of the following: (1) Felling and yarding of timber; (2) Bridge redecking or decking repair; (3) Bridge curbing or railing repair; (4) Bridge painting; (5) Other routine bridge repair above the high water line; (6) Water ford construction; (7) Water ford repair with equipment; (8) Removal of woody debris from culverts and culvert openings; p. 1 HB 2388 (9) Removal of woody debris not imbedded in the stream bed orstream banks from upstream bridge openings; (10) Beaver dam and beaver removal affecting road drainage andwater crossings; or (11) Single lane forestry road water crossing structures installedon waters designated in the Washington Administrative Code as "Type F"in the forest practices rules adopted under the authority of chapter76.09 RCW, including bridges, temporary culvert installation, andpermanent culvert installation.
